# ChessVolt
ChessVolt is an interactive chess learning, training, and practice platform for children, teenagers, adults, and developing chess players. It combines structured chess openings and variations, puzzles, historical games, and guided learning experiences with an AI-powered chess coach called Volt Coach. ChessVolt is designed to help players understand chess ideas, not merely memorize moves.
Understand Why. Practice. Improve. Volt Coach is ChessVolt's virtual chess coach and provides vocal, written, and visual coaching. It provides instructional guidance intended to help players understand why a move is strong, what strategic or tactical idea is involved, and how the position should be approached. The Volt Tracker system tracks the Volts that represent progress.

## About
- Chess puzzles and training exercises
- Chess Opening and variation study materials
- Famous games
- Learning paths and guided improvement study plans
- User progress tracking (with Volt)
- Analysis of users real games in chess.com and lichess.org. Shows blunders and mistakes and guides for the correct moves

## Main public pages
- https://chessvolt.com: Home page and primary entry point
- https://chessvolt.com/puzzles: Puzzles and tactical training resources
- https://chessvolt.com/openings: Openings and variations learning resources
- https://chessvolt.com/studies: Famous chess games and various exercises
- https://chessvolt.com/login: Login page
- https://chessvolt.com/signup: Sign-up page
- https://chessvolt.com/privacy: Privacy policy
- https://chessvolt.com/terms: Terms of service
- https://chessvolt.com/contact: Contact
- https://chessvolt.com/dashboard: Dashboard for logged in user
- https://chessvolt.com/volt-tracker: List of openings and puzzles tracked by Volt scores 
- https://chessvolt.com/profile: Profile page for logged in user
- https://chessvolt.com/analysis: Analysis page for recent Chess.com and Lichess.org games
